newsitem.title: UK: Syria cuts Feb light crude contract by eight cents.
newsitem.headline: Syria cuts Feb light crude contract by eight cents.

text.p: Syria cut the price of its light crude contract for February by eight cents a barrel to Dated Brent -27 cents from -35 cents in January, trade sources said.
Negotiations over the price of its heavy Souedie crude were still to be resolved with Syria asking -$4.20 cents a barrel and nearest bids around -$4.85 cents a barrel under Dated Brent.
"The best we can hope for is a rollover", one trader said.
The January official selling price for Souedie crude was dated Brent -$4.75 a barrel.
